verdict.rationale: Databricks provides several relevant pieces: MLflow's prompt registry offers 'Git-like versioning, commit messages, and rollback capabilities' for agent prompts, Databricks Apps supports 'git-based versioning' for agent code and deployment, notebooks have 'automatic versioning', and Delta Lake time travel lets you 'roll back a table' to a prior state. Together these cover versioning/rollback for AI automation artifacts (prompts, agent code, data), but there's no explicit, unified 'review and roll back' workflow for Jobs/Workflows/pipelines themselves as automations, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific capability. Missing for 10: explicit job/pipeline-level version history and rollback UI, and independent verification of the rollback experience.
